title: RC Prediction: A Python Package for Parameter-Aware Reservoir Computing
abstract: arXiv:2610.40984v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: A nonlinear dynamical system can be characterized by the autonomous evolution of its state in time and its dependence on system parameters. As a parameter varies, the dynamics can change quantitatively and, at bifurcation points, qualitatively. When the governing equations are unknown, a data-driven model should therefore capture both elements from observational data, rather than reproduce the dynamics at a single operating condition only. Parameter-aware reservoir computing (PARC) is a model-free framework for this purpose, where the parameter is supplied to a reservoir computer through an additional input channel. PARC is trained on time series recorded at several parameter values, and the trained reservoir, run in closed loop as an autonomous dynamical system, generates trajectories at parameter values that were never observed. rc_prediction is an open-source Python package that implements this workflow. translated_abstract: 非线性动力系统可以通过其状态随时间的自主演化以及其对系统参数的依赖性来刻画。当参数发生变化时，系统的动力学行为会发生定量改变，而在分岔点处则会发生定性改变。因此，当控制方程未知时，数据驱动模型应当从观测数据中同时捕捉这两个要素，而不仅仅是复现单一工况下的动力学。参数感知储备池计算（PARC）是一个为此目的设计的无模型框架，其中参数通过一个额外的输入通道提供给储备池计算机。PARC在多个参数值下记录的时间序列上进行训练，训练后的储备池作为一个自治动力系统以闭环方式运行，能够在从未观测过的参数值处生成系统轨迹。rc_prediction是一个实现该工作流程的开源Python软件包。它提供多参数……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文发布了开源Python软件包rc_prediction，实现了参数感知储备池计算（PARC）工作流程，可从多个参数值下的时间序列中学习动力学，并在从未观测过的参数值处生成系统的动力学轨迹。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces rc_prediction, an open-source Python package implementing the parameter-aware reservoir computing (PARC) workflow, which learns dynamical behavior from time series at multiple parameter values and generates trajectories at previously unobserved parameter values.
